subtitles.starry_mod.narrator.memorandum: Test text 1. Triggered on first equipping the Memorandum.
tooltip.starry_mod.cloud_lychee.desc.1: “To be honest, it looks like a lychee and tastes cool. But my friend says it’s like eating a cloud.”
tooltip.starry_mod.cloud_lychee.story.1: I wanted to save it—couldn’t bring myself to eat it. Left it too long. It floated away. Ahh...
tooltip.starry_mod.golden_tear_crystal.d: “Crying won’t solve anything. But after crying, you can sort out your emotions. Occasionally.”
tooltip.starry_mod.golden_tear_crystal.s: I’m a pessimist. If things are too calm, I suspect I’m trading today’s peace for some future tragedy. If things are too painful, I imagine the breaking point just ahead. But pessimism has its perks—at least I’m never surprised by a bad ending. I take it as normal, feeling that stories are supposed to end badly.

I admit it—it was the light that was too bright that made me cry, not the conversation with you. How long does it take to forget someone? If they weren’t that important, you’d forget quickly. But they are—they used to be a part of you.
Don’t rely too much on the sword in your hand, and forget where its power comes from—
tooltip.starry_mod.half_star_sword.story: A swordsman’s story is written by themselves.
tooltip.starry_mod.help.desc.2: Mutual aid is simply the same soul reaching out from two coordinates at once.
tooltip.starry_mod.help.effect.desc_pref: At night or in rain, if health is below 30%, gain
tooltip.starry_mod.help.effect.desc_suff: and clear negative effects. Next heal/buff also affects nearby allies
tooltip.starry_mod.help.story.1: It rained all night. I lay in the puddle at the mouth of the alley, half my body numb with cold. Occasionally someone passed by, glanced at me, slowed their pace, then hurried away. I understood — late night, rain, a person curled on the ground. No one wants trouble.
tooltip.starry_mod.help.story.2: Until a dark gray umbrella covered me from above. The young man under it crouched down, hooked his hands under my arms, and dragged me from the water to the dry spot by the wall. His coat was soaked through, cold against my face. When he was done, he stood up, turned, and walked back into the rain. The umbrella stayed in my hand.
tooltip.starry_mod.help.story.3: I got up. By the streetlight I saw two words carved into the handle — “Don’t thank me.” Below it, another line: “It’s you.”
tooltip.starry_mod.memorandum.desc.3: “When will someone write the first line?”
tooltip.starry_mod.memorandum.info.fragm: Unlocks 6 Memory Fragment slots when equipped
tooltip.starry_mod.memorandum.info.share: Other Life Fragments will share the current Stellar Value
tooltip.starry_mod.memorandum.story.2: Every page is white. Turn it, still white.
tooltip.starry_mod.memorandum.story.3: Wind passes through the spine, making a thin sound — as if asking: What are you doing here?
tooltip.starry_mod.memorandum.story.5: Maybe I’m waiting for someone to open me.
tooltip.starry_mod.original_star_ingot.d: “But it’s clearly the color of the sky.”
tooltip.starry_mod.original_star_ingot.s: The evening sky darkens inch by inch, from azure to deep blue, then to purple-gray. But the ingot’s blue never changes.
tooltip.starry_mod.perseverance.desc.1: “If things don’t go your way, does perseverance still mean anything?”
tooltip.starry_mod.perseverance.desc.2: If the ending doesn’t satisfy you, then it’s not the ending yet.
tooltip.starry_mod.perseverance.effect.h: When Shared Stellar Value is above 100, gain
tooltip.starry_mod.perseverance.effect.l: When Shared Stellar Value is below 100, gain
tooltip.starry_mod.perseverance.story.1: “So, my answer is: if things don’t go your way, first stop and ask yourself—are you “stubbornly” banging your head against a wall, or “resiliently” exploring? If the former, changing direction isn’t giving up—it’s wisdom. If the latter, please keep going.”
tooltip.starry_mod.perseverance.story.2: “Truly brave men dare to face the bleakness of life, and dare to look directly at the streaming blood. What grievous mourners and happy ones they are! Yet the Creator oft designs for the mediocre, to wash away old traces with the passage of time, leaving only pale red bloodstains and faint sorrow. In this pale red blood and faint sorrow, people steal a moment’s respite, sustaining this world that is human yet inhuman. I know not when such a world will come to an end!” ——In Memory of Liu Hezhen
tooltip.starry_mod.raw_original_star.des: “Wrapped in a rough blue crust, gold gleams within the ore—that’s right!”
tooltip.starry_mod.raw_original_star.sto: I don't know where this came from, but its flickering light does not belong to this world.
tooltip.starry_mod.shattered_star_crysta: "Do you still remember that rainy evening?"
"I do. You pressed me against the window to peek outside. Your breath fogged up my face."
Only you knew — for three years, you never dared to hold tight.
Afraid you’d hurt her. Afraid that if you held too tight, she would shatter.
In the end, it was you who broke.
Shattered into countless pieces, every single one reflecting her profile.
You kept her the closest to your chest — afraid she’d break, afraid she’d catch cold, afraid someone would touch her.
You even learned to hold things with your left hand, just so your right would always be free — in case she ever needed something.
But she never needed you. Not because she was cold — she just never knew someone had been holding her all along.
In the end, you didn’t drop her, and nobody took her away.
You just let go. Because you’d held on for too long.
Your palms grew calluses, your bones ached, even your heartbeat had slowed a beat.
She never knew she was made of glass.
She thought she was just walking, talking, laughing like everyone else.
tooltip.starry_mod.wait.desc.1: “Don’t wait. Be brave and step out.”
tooltip.starry_mod.wait.desc.2: This return to an old place is not because I miss you. It’s to bring back the “me” I used to be.
tooltip.starry_mod.wait.story.1: This return to an old place is not because I miss you.
tooltip.starry_mod.wait.story.2: I asked myself over and over: am I warming myself with memories again? Standing here now, the wind still blows from the same direction — and I know for certain. It’s not for you.
tooltip.starry_mod.wait.story.3: I’ve come to bring back the “me” I used to be.
tooltip.starry_mod.wait.story.4: The person who would stop for a cloud, who believed tomorrow was worth waiting for and could close their eyes in peace — he’s been stuck on this road all along. Not because he got lost. Because I chose not to look back.
tooltip.starry_mod.wait.story.5: Today I’ve come for him. I crouch under the old tree, press my hand into the bark, and tell him I’m sorry for making him wait so long. I’m not here to miss anyone. I’m here to take him home.
tooltip.starry_mod.wait.story.6: The noodle shop changed its sign, but the vinegar tastes the same. When I stand up after eating, I hear a soft click in my bones — something has fallen back into place.
tooltip.starry_mod.wait.story.7: This trip has nothing to do with you. I’ve simply walked out from the rubble, leading that child who dared to laugh, dared to lose sleep, dared to hope for tomorrow.
tooltip.starry_mod.wait.story.8: He takes my hand and says: let’s go home. I say yes. This time, I’ll never leave him behind again.
